title: NATS request/reply pipelines.memory (studio → pipelines)
description: From API 1.14. Core NATS request/reply on subject `pipelines.memory` (queue group `pipelines`), bare JSON, for /v1/studio/memory (plan 16.6). Pipelines owns memory (LangGraph's Postgres store in `pipelines`, namespace <owner_id>/pipeline/<pipeline_id>) and answers only inside the request owner's namespace: an item of another owner or another pipeline is `not_found`. Studio checks first that the pipeline is the caller's (RLS), then asks; it waits 5 s (no answer: 503). `list`: every item, newest first (`kind` filters); `create`: a note typed by the user (source user); `delete`: one item; `clear`: every item of the pipeline, and the namespace is marked deleted so later writes are refused (studio sends it when the pipeline is deleted). Batches already started keep their snapshot.

ok.description: list: items (at most 500, the namespace's cap; newest first, cut to fit 900 000 bytes of UTF-8 JSON with `truncated` true); create: item; delete and clear: deleted (how many)

truncated.description: list only: true when older items were left out to keep the reply under NATS max_payload

error.description: `memory is full (500 items); delete some first` (full), `memory item not found` (not_found)
